title: European Commission proposes renaming and expanding heritage label scheme
excerpt: The proposal would rename the European Heritage Label to the European Heritage List and extend eligibility to additional countries.
bodyHtml:
The European Commission announced on October 23, 2026, a proposal to renew and reinforce the legal framework of the European Heritage Label. This scheme, originally adopted in 2011, provides recognition to sites of symbolic value that have played a role in shaping the history, culture, and integration of Europe.

Under the new proposal, the initiative would be renamed the European Heritage List. The framework would expand to include sites in Iceland, Liechtenstein, and Norway, as well as candidate or potential candidate countries for EU membership associated with the Creative Europe programme. The plan also introduces a prize to reward selected sites for their impact and aims to establish clearer criteria for the selection and monitoring process.

The proposal will now be submitted for negotiation to the European Parliament and the Council.
topic: Commission proposes stronger recognition of European heritage sites*
